g.text: C1 local verifier and commit cost
Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · Apple M5 Ultra · fixed prefix position 1022 · k = T
Each group contains 10 alternating AB/BA pairs. Grey lines connect the same timing group; spread is not a confidence interval.
Device baseline only: 200 displayed timed calls of 400 audited calls. Host-sequential baseline is excluded.
Local cost, assuming all T tokens are useful. Drafting, acceptance/rejection, scheduler and HTTP costs are absent. No Pareto claim.
Source: closed E054 independent audit 7fe77b62600f · raw timing ledger b83e01563176
